# llms.txt - AI discoverability

> Rayen Ben Aissa's personal portfolio and projects.

## About

Rayen Ben Aissa is a Full Stack Developer from Tunisia specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. He builds modern web applications and tools.

## Pages

- [Home](https://github.com/ErenYea9er69/3D-portfolio-winxp): Portfolio homepage with projects, skills, work experience, and social links.
- [Blog](/blog): Technical articles about web development.
- [Projects](/projects): Web applications and open source projects.

## Key Projects

- [MyNet](https://github.com/ErenYea9er69/MyNet): Windows networking tool (C# / .NET 8) that scans your local network, discovers devices, and lets you block or throttle their bandwidth using ARP spoofing / Layer-2 techniques.
- [ScopyAI](https://github.com/ErenYea9er69/ScopyAI): Next.js web app for Scopy (AI-powered product). Uses OpenAI, Supabase, Tavily search, and PDF generation.
- [anime-site (Tsune)](https://anime-site-d5x9.vercel.app/): Next.js anime streaming / browsing site that pulls data via Consumet API, with video player support (Vidstack/HLS), Prisma, auth, and a modern UI.
- [3D-portfolio-winxp](https://3d-portfolio-winxp.vercel.app): Interactive Windows XP-themed personal portfolio built with Next.js.
- [AnyBook](https://any-book.vercel.app): Next.js app for browsing structured book summaries.

## Technical Stack

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, CSS3, HTML5
Backend & Databases: Node.js, Express.js, Neon PostgreSQL, REST APIs, MongoDB, Prisma
Tools & DevOps: Git, GitHub, Vercel, VS Code, Vite, Docker
Exploring: Rust, Tauri, AI/ML, WebSockets, PWA
